purpose: Codex hosted web search on the S24 (OpenClaw 2026.10.9, @openclaw/codex 2026.10.9). (1) fs-safe refuses every temp workspace on Android: /data and /data/data are owned by the platform uid 1000 (not root) and, like /data/data/<app>/files, are group-writable 0771 without sticky bit; on Android only (ANDROID_ROOT, TERMUX_VERSION or a Termux PREFIX) the system owner is trusted like root and group write on non-private ancestors owned by the system or by this app with its own per-app group is admitted, while the leaf root and child stay strictly private. (2) The bounded Codex turn caps model/list at 5 s, which the phone app-server exceeds after ChatGPT auth; the cap becomes 20 s within the same overall deadline. (3) The hosted search worker always takes the live default model; OPENCLAW_CODEX_WEB_SEARCH_MODEL selects an explicit model (gateway-start exports the measured fastest correct one) and OPENCLAW_CODEX_WEB_SEARCH_TIMEOUT_S optionally overrides the search timeout. Unset, both behave exactly as shipped. Network reachability of the musl Codex binary (no /etc/resolv.conf on Android) is handled by the codex-termux.sh launcher, not by this set.

replacements:
timeoutMs: Math.min(params.timeoutMs, 2e4), // Samantha codex-android-compat: model/list exceeds 5 s on the S24
		signal: params.signal,
model: process.env.OPENCLAW_CODEX_WEB_SEARCH_MODEL ? { mode: "required", id: process.env.OPENCLAW_CODEX_WEB_SEARCH_MODEL } : { mode: "live-default" }, // Samantha codex-android-compat
